meta_description: 22 colleges and institutes in Knowledge Park II and III, Greater Noida: official admission and office contacts, and the walk from Knowledge Park II metro.
excerpt: 22 colleges and institutes in Knowledge Park II and III, Greater Noida: addresses, admission and office contacts (plus registrar and department contacts where the college lists them) from each college's own website, and the walk from Knowledge Park II metro. Checked 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Which colleges are in Knowledge Park 2, Greater Noida?
faq.answer: Colleges in Knowledge Park II include Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology (GCET), Galgotias Institute of Management and Technology (GIMT), Galgotias College of Pharmacy, GNIOT, NIET, IILM University, BIMTECH, Mangalmay, Lloyd Law College, Lloyd Institute of Engineering & Technology and Lloyd Institute of Management & Technology. All are within about 1.6 km of Knowledge Park II metro station.

faq.question: Which colleges are in Knowledge Park 3, Greater Noida?
faq.answer: Colleges in Knowledge Park III include Sharda University, GL Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management, GL Bajaj Institute of Management & Research, GL Bajaj College of Technology and Management, KCC Institute, Amity University's Greater Noida campus, ITS Engineering College, JIMS (JEMTEC), Accurate Group of Institutions, Dronacharya Group of Institutions and Delhi Technical Campus.

faq.question: Which college is nearest to Knowledge Park II metro station?
faq.answer: Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology (GCET), which shares its campus with GIMT and Galgotias College of Pharmacy. Google Maps shows a 350 m walk, about 5 minutes. GNIOT is next, about 700 m or 10 minutes on foot.

faq.question: Is Galgotias University in Knowledge Park?
faq.answer: No. Galgotias University is on the Yamuna Expressway, about 15 km by road from Pari Chowk metro. Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology (GCET) is a different institution in Knowledge Park II, next to Knowledge Park II metro station.

faq.question: Which metro station is nearest to Sharda University and GL Bajaj?
faq.answer: Knowledge Park II on the Aqua Line. Sharda University is about 3 km by road and GL Bajaj about 2.5 km. In October 2026 an Uber bike from the station cost about ₹30 and an Uber Auto to Sharda about ₹59.

faq.question: Knowledge Park 2 mein kaun kaun se college hain?
faq.answer: Knowledge Park 2 mein GCET, GIMT, Galgotias College of Pharmacy, GNIOT, NIET, IILM University, BIMTECH, Mangalmay aur Lloyd ke teen college hain. Sabke liye sabse paas ka metro Knowledge Park II (Aqua Line) hai. GCET station se 5 minute paidal hai.
